observation_summary: The compiler was incorrectly skipping dependency management logic when the compilation level was set to WHITESPACE_ONLY, because an overly restrictive condition (!options.skipAllPasses) prevented the dependency management pass from executing.
reasoning_summary: The fix involved removing a conditional check (!options.skipAllPasses) that was preventing the dependency management logic from running. This is a classic case of an incorrect guard/predicate logic error, which falls under the 'Checking' category in ODC.
evidence_used: The fix diff shows the removal of '!options.skipAllPasses' from an 'if' statement.
The bug report states that dependency management was ignored for WHITESPACE_ONLY compilation level.
The fix enables the dependency management logic by removing the restrictive condition.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: The fix is not a rewrite of the algorithm itself, but rather the removal of a guard that was incorrectly preventing the algorithm from executing.
This is not a missing design capability, but a configuration/logic error in the existing control flow.
